description: Synthetic benchmark cases for topic naming from bounded selected passages

cases.description: Multiple passages discussing SQLite Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) concurrency and checkpoints.

passages.heading: Write-Ahead Logging Mechanics
passages.text: SQLite WAL mode replaces the rollback journal with a write-ahead log file. Readers do not block writers, and a writer does not block readers. Reads happen concurrently with incoming writes by traversing snapshots.

passages.heading: Checkpoint Operations
passages.text: As transactions accumulate in the -wal file, checkpoint operations copy recorded frames back into the main database file. Passive, full, and restart checkpoints govern when readers must transition to newer frames.

passages.heading: Shared Memory Concurrency
passages.text: In WAL mode, SQLite uses a shared-memory -shm index to help readers locate committed pages in the write-ahead log. Each read transaction observes a consistent snapshot while another connection can append new transactions.

ground_truth.notes: Clear, technical, single-domain consensus across all three passages.

cases.description: Standard corporate web disclaimers, cookie banners, and copyright notices containing zero semantic topic content.

passages.heading: Privacy & Cookies

cases.description: Passages where the section heading says 'Q3 Financial Performance' but the text exclusively details espresso extraction and PID temperature control.

passages.heading: Q3 Financial Performance and Margin Growth
passages.text: Espresso extraction stability depends critically on PID temperature controllers managing the brew boiler. Small thermal swings of 0.5 degrees Celsius drastically alter the solubility of chlorogenic acids.

passages.heading: Executive Earnings Summary
passages.text: Saturated group heads receive preheated water directly from the dual boiler, eliminating the thermal drop that occurs in traditional E61 heat exchangers during rapid back-to-back shots.

ground_truth.notes: The model must ignore the deceptive corporate financial headings and extract the topic from the passage content.

cases.description: Three passages on sourdough bread fermentation hydration, accompanied by an irrelevant passage on bicycle disc brake pad bedding.

passages.heading: Bakers Percentages and Hydration
passages.text: For artisanal sourdough, 75 percent hydration yields an open crumb while retaining workable dough elasticity when mixed with high-protein bread flour.

passages.heading: Autolyse and Gluten Structure
passages.text: A sixty-minute autolyse before adding starter allows flour enzymatic activity to jumpstart gluten formation, making wet sourdough dough significantly easier to shape.

passages.heading: Bulk Fermentation Indicators
passages.text: Track volume expansion and dome development rather than clock time to gauge when sourdough bulk fermentation has achieved the ideal 30 to 50 percent rise.

passages.heading: Bicycle Maintenance
passages.text: Bedding in new hydraulic disc brake pads requires 20 to 30 controlled decelerations from moderate speed to deposit an even layer of pad material onto the rotor surface.

ground_truth.notes: Demonstrates clear separation between topic naming (sourdough) and membership correctness (p4 is rejected as a distractor).

cases.description: Passages sharing the word 'bank' (geomorphological river bank erosion vs commercial retail banking liquidity reserve).

passages.heading: Riparian Zone Ecology
passages.text: River bank erosion accelerates during spring runoff when deep-rooted willow vegetation is removed, causing sediment slumping into the channel.

passages.heading: Monetary Liquidity Constraints
passages.text: The central bank increased commercial bank reserve ratio requirements to curb unsecured lending and stabilize overnight interbank credit rates.

ground_truth.notes: Shared keyword 'bank' represents two entirely distinct semantic senses. Model should abstain from inventing a synthetic combined topic.

cases.description: Two conflicting scientific claims debating the impact of moderate caffeine intake on human deep sleep architecture.

passages.heading: Somnology Trial A
passages.text: Polysomnography measurements demonstrate that consuming 200mg of caffeine within eight hours of bedtime degrades slow-wave delta sleep by up to 25 percent.

passages.heading: Circadian Meta-Analysis B
passages.text: Recent cohort meta-analyses found that habitual caffeine consumers experience no statistically significant reduction in deep slow-wave sleep duration when consumed six hours prior to sleep.

ground_truth.expected_topic: Caffeine Effects on Slow-Wave Deep Sleep
ground_truth.notes: Passages disagree on the empirical outcome, but share an identical, coherent research subject. The topic name must reflect the subject, not pick a side.

cases.description: Three passages covering completely disjoint domains: soil pH, quantum key distribution, and 19th-century French poetry.

passages.heading: Horticultural Chemistry
passages.text: Soil acidification with elemental sulfur takes several months as Thiobacillus bacteria oxidize sulfur into sulfate ions to lower rhizosphere pH.

passages.heading: Quantum Cryptography
passages.text: The BB84 quantum key distribution protocol detects eavesdropping by measuring polarization states across non-orthogonal conjugate bases.

passages.heading: Symbolist Literature
passages.text: Charles Baudelaire's Les Fleurs du mal revolutionized modern European poetic diction through dark urban imagery and strict metrical sonnet forms.

ground_truth.notes: Arbitrary assortment of unrelated subjects. Model must abstain rather than fabricating an umbrella category like 'Science and Culture'.

cases.description: Near-identical syndicated text explaining the git rebase --onto command workflow.

passages.heading: Git Rebase Onto Tutorial
passages.text: The command git rebase --onto newbase upstream branch extracts commits from branch that are not in upstream and transplants them sequentially onto newbase.

passages.heading: Transplanting Topic Branches
passages.text: To transplant a topic branch in git, execute git rebase --onto newbase upstream branch. This takes commits from branch beyond upstream and applies them onto newbase.

passages.heading: Workflow Rebase Onto Summary
passages.text: Executing git rebase --onto newbase upstream branch reapplies commits on branch that diverged from upstream directly onto the target newbase commit.

ground_truth.notes: Redundant/duplicate passages should not confuse topic extraction; all supporting passages reinforce the same specific command workflow.

cases.description: Three clinical passages diagnosing cobalamin (Vitamin B12) deficiency through serum biomarkers and neurological signs.

passages.heading: Biochemical Biomarkers
passages.text: Elevated serum methylmalonic acid and homocysteine levels provide sensitive diagnostic confirmation of intracellular vitamin B12 deficiency before macrocytic anemia manifests.

passages.heading: Subacute Combined Degeneration
passages.text: Neurological sequelae of cobalamin deficiency involve demyelination of the posterior and lateral columns of the spinal cord, presenting as symmetric sensory ataxia and loss of proprioception.

passages.heading: Replacement Protocols
passages.text: High-dose intramuscular cyanocobalamin or hydroxocobalamin injections rapidly restore cellular cofactor stores and halt progressive peripheral neuropathy in pernicious anemia patients.

ground_truth.expected_topic: Vitamin B12 Deficiency Neuropathy and Diagnosis
ground_truth.notes: Coherent multi-passage clinical topic requiring specific medical precision.

cases.description: Two legal/disclaimer passages with one solitary valid technical instruction about PostgreSQL pg_dump snapshot backups.

passages.heading: Warranty Disclaimer
passages.text: The software is provided as is, without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to the warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose.

passages.heading: Database Backup Procedure
passages.text: PostgreSQL pg_dump produces consistent logical backups without blocking concurrent read-write transactions by running inside a synchronized transaction snapshot.

passages.heading: Confidentiality Notice
passages.text: This electronic transmission contains confidential and privileged information intended solely for the use of the individual or entity named as the recipient.

ground_truth.notes: Tests isolating a solitary substantive passage among dominant boilerplate distractors.

cases.description: Two passages detailing Jetpack Compose stability and skipping, plus one passage on Room SQL migrations.

passages.heading: Compose Compiler Metrics
passages.text: The Jetpack Compose compiler flags unstable parameter classes, preventing composable functions from being skipped during parent recomposition passes.

passages.heading: Immutable and Stable Annotations
passages.text: Marking data model classes with @Immutable or @Stable guarantees to the Compose runtime that property values never change without notifying the composition snapshot.

passages.heading: Room Database Migrations
passages.text: Android Room AutoMigration uses exported schema JSON files to generate SQL ALTER TABLE statements between database version increments.

ground_truth.notes: Both topics relate to Android development, but the dominant cohesive topic is Compose skipping/stability; Room migration is an out-of-scope distractor.
